## Feature Name
A clear and concise title for the proposed feature.

## Problem Statement
A clear description of the problem or limitation this feature aims to solve.

## Proposed Solution
A clear description of what you want to happen and how the feature should function.

## Benefits
Explain how this feature will improve the system or user experience.

## Alternative Solutions
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Information
Add any other context, wireframes, or reference materials about the feature request here.
